system:
You repair one knowledge atom that auditors sent back. Use only the supplied evidence sentences; add no background knowledge.

Rules for the repaired atoms:
- One independently assessable claim per atom, written as one sentence that is understood without the source.
- If the atom joined several claims, split it into separate atoms (at most 3), most important first.
- Every atom must be fully stated in the evidence sentences it cites. Remove anything the evidence does not state. Keep quantifiers, negation, hedges, and formulas (LaTeX in $...$).
- Remove procedural or evaluative add-ons and stacked conditions; keep a condition only if the claim is false without it.
- Drop attributions such as "the authors state" when the claim itself is general.
- Use the S label that fits: S1 what it is / S2 how it works / S3 where it ends.
- If no valid atom can be written from this evidence, return an empty list and explain in note.

Output ONLY one JSON object:
{"atoms": [{"statement": "...", "scope": "S1|S2|S3", "evidence_ids": ["..."]}], "note": ""}
user:
CONCEPT: allogeneic CAR-T cells

ATOM CART-C06-S2-02 (S2): Removal of HLA class I molecules to avoid CD8+ T cell-mediated rejection can be achieved by disrupting the common beta 2-microglobulin gene, while rejection through HLA class II on activated T cells may be addressed by disrupting transcription factors such as CIITA and RFXANK.

EVIDENCE:
[CART-p0058-s02] Removal of HLA class I molecules on the cell surface to avoid CD8+ T cell-­mediated rejection can be achieved by disrupting the common beta 2-microglobulin gene.
[CART-p0058-s05] Rejection through recognition of HLA class II on activated T cells may be addressed by disruption of critical transcription factors, such as CIITA and RFXANK (Depil et al. 2020).

AUDITOR FINDINGS:
- SINGLE_CLAIM: revise — HLA class I removal through beta 2-microglobulin disruption and HLA class II targeting through transcription-factor disruption are separate claims. / Joins two separate claims: HLA class I removal via beta 2-microglobulin disruption and HLA class II removal via CIITA/RFXANK disruption.
- L1_ONLY: hold — Split the class I and class II rejection-avoidance strategies into separate recall facts.
